accuracyFlags: 'Aim for at least 35 metres above sea level or a kilometre inland' - official Get Ready wording is 'move immediately to the nearest high ground or as far inland as you can'; the 35 m/1 km figures need a cited source or removal.
'The 2016 Kaikoura earthquake generated waves within minutes of the shaking' - arrival times varied (tens of minutes at Kaikoura); verify and soften.
'Long or strong, get gone' attribution is correct (NEMA/Get Ready) but the official link should be dated 2026.
